data.title: Crypto-to-Cash Desk — Ephemeral Wallet and Unlicensed OTC Indicators
data.description: Detects crypto-to-cash desk operations that convert USDT to physical currency with minimal or no KYC, generating fresh wallet addresses per transaction to defeat blockchain tracing. These unlicensed OTC operations represent the final monetization layer in stablecoin laundering pipelines, bridging the gap between on-chain cryptocurrency and usable physical cash. ICIJ investigators documented such operations in Dubai and Eastern European cities during the Coin Laundry investigation, with one desk processing $2 million in volume over 10 days on the TRON network alone — and critically, that desk did not appear in any major blockchain analytics provider attribution database (Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic). The detection targets ephemeral wallets (< 7 days old, < 3 prior transactions) receiving USDT from multiple distinct sources on TRON, where the destination wallet is not attributed in any known analytics or exchange Proof-of-Reserves database.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_ephemeral_wallet AND (filter_desk_aggregation OR filter_unattributed)

enrichment_required.source: Blockchain analytics — days since first transaction involving the destination wallet address
Blockchain analytics — total transaction count for the destination wallet address at time of current transaction
Blockchain analytics — count of distinct source wallet addresses that have sent to the destination wallet in the preceding 72 hours
Cross-reference destination address against collected exchange Proof-of-Reserves CSV datasets. False if address does not appear in any PoR dataset.
Cross-reference destination address against Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic, or Arkham Intelligence attribution databases. False if address is unattributed in all checked databases.

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Crypto-to-Cash Desk Ephemeral Wallet Detection
// Detects unlicensed OTC desk patterns on TRON: ephemeral wallets receiving from multiple sources
token_symbol="USDT" chain="TRON" amount_usd>=500
destination_wallet_age_days<=7
destination_wallet_tx_count<3
| groupBy(to_address, function=[
    count(distinct=from_address, as=unique_senders),
    sum(amount_usd, as=total_volume),
    collect([transaction_hash, from_address, amount_usd, @timestamp])
  ], span=72h)
| unique_senders >= 5
| match(to_address, file="exchange_por_addresses.csv", field="address", strict=false, include=false)
| match(to_address, file="arkham_attributed.csv", field="address", strict=false, include=false)
| sort(total_volume, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Crypto-to-Cash Desk Ephemeral Wallet Detection")`
`comment("Detects unlicensed OTC desk patterns on TRON")`
index=flame_blockchain sourcetype=flame:chain_monitoring
  token_symbol="USDT" chain="TRON" amount_usd>=500
  destination_wallet_age_days<=7
  destination_wallet_tx_count<3
| lookup exchange_por_addresses to_address AS to_address OUTPUT exchange_name AS por_match
| lookup arkham_attributions to_address AS to_address OUTPUT entity_name AS arkham_match
| where isnull(por_match) AND isnull(arkham_match)
| bin _time span=72h
| stats dc(from_address) AS unique_senders,
        sum(amount_usd) AS total_volume,
        count AS tx_count,
        values(from_address) AS source_wallets
  BY to_address, _time
| where unique_senders >= 5
| sort - total_volume
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Crypto-to-Cash Desk Ephemeral Wallet Detection
-- Detects unlicensed OTC desk patterns: ephemeral wallets receiving from multiple sources
SELECT
  t.to_address AS desk_wallet,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.from_address) AS unique_senders,
  SUM(t.amount_usd) AS total_volume_usd,
  MIN(t.block_timestamp) AS first_tx,
  MAX(t.block_timestamp) AS last_tx,
  w.first_seen_date,
  w.total_transaction_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN wallet_metadata w ON t.to_address = w.wallet_address
LEFT JOIN proof_of_reserves por ON t.to_address = por.wallet_address
LEFT JOIN arkham_attributions ark ON t.to_address = ark.wallet_address
WHERE t.token_symbol = 'USDT'
  AND t.chain = 'TRON'
  AND t.amount_usd >= 500
  AND t.block_timestamp >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND w.total_transaction_count < 3
  AND w.first_seen_date > CURRENT_DATE - 7
  AND por.wallet_address IS NULL
  AND ark.wallet_address IS NULL
GROUP BY t.to_address, w.first_seen_date, w.total_transaction_count
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.from_address) >= 5
ORDER BY total_volume_usd DESC

references: ICIJ Coin Laundry Investigation (2024-2025) — field visits to crypto-to-cash desks in Dubai and Eastern Europe
ICIJ/OpenCorporates, The Modern Money Trail Crypto & Cash webinar (2026) — $2M volume from single unattributed TRON desk in 10 days
FinCEN Advisory on Illicit Activity Involving Convertible Virtual Currency (May 2019)
falsepositives: Newly created wallets for legitimate P2P trading on LocalBitcoins or Paxful
Payment processor wallets during initial operational period
DeFi protocol wallets receiving from multiple depositors shortly after deployment
